formulation.deisdev.preserving_sealant: Protects against melting, decay and weathering.
formulation.deisdev.structural_stasis: Holds supported shapes and gravity blocks in place.
formulation.deisdev.temporal_stasis: Pauses standard ticks and supported transfers.

overlay.deisdev.surface_preview: Center first · Some targets may be skipped

item.deisdev.serum.settings: Strength and loaded duration are set by the server.
formulation.deisdev.suspicious_time_seru: Temporary acceleration; speed is rolled for each application.
config.deisdev.gameplay.description: Adjust time serums, enchanting, treatment limits and component trades for the current world or server. Single-player owners and server admins can save changes.
config.deisdev.gameplay.title: Preserve · Gameplay
config.deisdev.gameplay.offline: Join a world to edit gameplay settings. These are the built-in defaults.
config.deisdev.gameplay.unavailable: Server settings could not be reached. Reopen this screen after joining a compatible server.
config.deisdev.gameplay.readonly: Server settings · Only the single-player owner or a server admin can edit these values.
config.deisdev.gameplay.override: World override active. Saves apply to this world and everyone playing in it.
config.deisdev.gameplay.datapack: Using data pack settings. Saving creates a gameplay override for this world.
config.deisdev.gameplay.future: Changes affect future applications and new villager offers. Applied serums keep their saved speed and remaining time.
config.deisdev.gameplay.denied: Nothing saved: you no longer have permission. Current server values are shown.
config.deisdev.gameplay.stale: Nothing saved: another edit or reload changed the settings. Review the current values and try again.
config.deisdev.gameplay.invalid: Nothing saved: check the speed range and ensure levels spent do not exceed the required level.
config.deisdev.gameplay.io_error: Nothing saved: the server could not write the settings file. Current server values are shown.
config.deisdev.gameplay.busy: Nothing saved: requests arrived too quickly. Reopen this screen and try again.
config.deisdev.gameplay.multiplier.descr: 2 means twice the supported tick rate. Range: 1.01–8. Independent clocks and external networks keep their usual rate.
config.deisdev.gameplay.suspicious_min.d: Lowest speed that can be rolled for each new application. Must not exceed the maximum.
config.deisdev.gameplay.suspicious_max.d: Highest speed that can be rolled. The result is saved on the treated block.
config.deisdev.gameplay.duration.descrip: Applies to both serums. Lifetime counts only while the chunk ticks. Fractions are allowed; rounded to the nearest game tick. Maximum: 1,440 minutes.
config.deisdev.gameplay.enchant_level.de: Minimum player level needed to enchant Time Serum into Suspicious Time Serum.
config.deisdev.gameplay.enchant_levels_s: Levels consumed per enchantment. Must not exceed the required level.
config.deisdev.gameplay.lapis_cost.descr: Lapis consumed for each Suspicious Time Serum enchantment.
config.deisdev.gameplay.bookshelves.desc: Unobstructed bookshelves required around the enchanting table.
config.deisdev.gameplay.partial.descript: Allow supported treatments that cannot cover every external clock, network or automation route.
config.deisdev.gameplay.chunk_limit.desc: Maximum treated positions in one chunk. Lowering this limit keeps existing treatments.
config.deisdev.gameplay.area_limit.descr: Maximum positions accepted from a 3×3 surface application. Range: 1–9.
config.deisdev.gameplay.enabled.descript: Allow future applications of this compound. Disabling it keeps existing treatments intact.
config.deisdev.gameplay.reset.descriptio: Immediately remove this world's gameplay override and use its current data pack settings. Unsaved edits on this screen are discarded. Existing treatments and offers stay intact.
config.deisdev.gameplay.trades.descripti: Expand a component to change its offer. Disable every offer to stop new component trades. Existing villagers keep their saved offers and stock.
config.deisdev.gameplay.trade.enabled.de: Allow this offer when villagers generate new trades.
config.deisdev.gameplay.trade.level.desc: Profession level at which the offer appears, from 1 (novice) to 5 (master).
config.deisdev.gameplay.trade.emeralds.d: Base emerald price before vanilla discounts and demand.
config.deisdev.gameplay.trade.count.desc: Number of components delivered per purchase.
config.deisdev.gameplay.trade.max_uses.d: Number of times the offer can be used before the villager needs to restock.
Second ingredient cost. Set to 0 to charge only emeralds.
